headline: GOLD IDLES AT $4,038 AS FED DELIVERS OCTOBER DECISION — DECEMBER NOW THE REAL QUESTION
snippet: Spot gold held at $4,037–$4,055 an ounce as the Federal Reserve delivered its October rate decision Wednesday, with markets looking past the announcement to December guidance language and Thursday's PCE inflation print. Analysts set bull and bear targets at $4,125 and $3,940 respectively.

headline: USA RARE EARTH, US ANTIMONY EACH SPIKE 11% AS CRITICAL MINERALS BID BROADENS
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) and United States Antimony (UAMY) each jumped 11% on October 27 as a broad critical minerals bid lifted the sector, with Critical Metals (CRML) adding 8%. Analysts cited Australian domestic refining policy and renewed US supply chain positioning heading into 2027 legislative windows.

headline: CRITICAL METALS CRML DROPS 7% AS EUROPEAN LITHIUM DILUTION FLOODS NASDAQ
snippet: Critical Metals Corporation (CRML) fell 7% Wednesday after its acquisition of ASX-listed European Lithium became effective the prior day, with freshly issued shares arriving on Nasdaq triggering dilution-driven selling. USA Rare Earth retreated 3% and MP Materials eased alongside as the day-after hangover hit.

headline: ELEMENTAL ROYALTY BANKS $200M CASH, BAGS RUBY HILL SILVER STREAM IN ORION MEGA-DEAL
snippet: Elemental Royalty closed four of five royalties and streams from Orion Mine Finance funds for US$200M cash plus 4.3M Elemental shares, adding a 50% silver stream on Nevada's Ruby Hill Complex, a 5% gold stream on Guinea's Kouroussa mine, and a royalty on Mexico's La Negra project. The company simultaneously expanded its credit facility from $150M to $250M.

headline: COPPER DISCOVERY EXTENDS 1.2 KILOMETRES: 40.8M HOLE HITS 1.09% CUEQ CORE
snippet: A junior copper explorer reported a 1.2-kilometre step-out drill result of 40.8 metres at 0.63% CuEq, including a 15-metre high-grade intercept at 1.09% CuEq, extending the footprint of a new copper discovery. The result arrives as LME copper holds near record levels on sustained AI data centre and grid infrastructure demand.

headline: JUNIOR TABLES ASSAYS NEAR KSM-TREATY CREEK — BC'S GREAT PORPHYRY BELT STAYS HOT
snippet: A junior miner released new assay results from ground adjacent to the KSM and Treaty Creek project corridor in northwest British Columbia, one of the world's largest undeveloped gold-copper porphyry belts. Seabridge Gold holds KSM and Tudor Gold is advancing Treaty Creek toward a PEA; regional interest has intensified through 2026.

headline: KINROSS GOLD Q3 DROPS TONIGHT — STREET SEES $2.11B REVENUE, $0.59 EPS
snippet: Kinross Gold (KGC/K.TO) releases Q3 2026 financial and operating results after market close tonight, with analyst consensus at $2.11B revenue and $0.59 adjusted EPS against a gold price that averaged roughly $4,400+ in the quarter. The company guided full-year 2026 production at 2 million gold-equivalent ounces; conference call follows October 29 at 8 a.m. EDT.

headline: ELDORADO GOLD: TWO NEW MINES IN 2027, 40% PRODUCTION GROWTH — AND THE MARKET HASN'T PRICED IT
snippet: Motley Fool highlights Eldorado Gold's 2027 production story: Skouries in Greece targeting commercial production in Q4 2026 and a second mine ramping concurrently, with management guiding 40% year-over-year production growth. The analysis argues Eldorado remains one of few senior miners with credible organic volume expansion in the current cycle, yet trades at a discount to peers.

headline: WESCAN GOLDFIELDS SPOTS VISIBLE GOLD IN FIRST 2026 DRILL HOLE AT MUNRO LAKE, SASK
snippet: Wescan Goldfields (TSXV: WGF) reported encouraging drill core observations from ML26-005, the first hole of its 2026 program at Munro Lake in Saskatchewan. Visible gold was observed in core; assay results are pending. Munro Lake sits on the Athabasca Basin margin, a region better known for uranium but hosting underexplored gold targets.

headline: COPPER EXPLORER BOOTS UP 10,000-FOOT NEVADA DRILL AS GLOBAL SUPPLY SHORTAGE BITES
snippet: A Nevada-focused junior copper explorer launched a 10,000-foot drill program targeting porphyry-style mineralization as the global copper supply shortage narrative intensifies into year-end. LME copper has held near record levels through October on AI data centre buildout, EV adoption, and grid electrification demand with no near-term relief from major producers.
